what: Service stopped: B (still a member) leaves two notes that queue, walks into 1,0 and back, then quits from Play (Browser.close); main writes the day's visit into the outbox on quit

actions.eval: (async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) { const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world.value; if (w.status.link !== 'online') break; await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 250)); } return 'ok' })()

(async () => { const S = await import('/state/index.ts'); const w = S.useHistoryStore.getState().world.value; return JSON.stringify({ head: w.now.head.n, link: w.status.link, role: w.status.role, writable: w.status.writable, pending: w.status.pending, refused: w.status.refused, error: w.status.error?.code ?? null }) })()

(() => { const f = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-layer=notes] input, [data-layer=notes] textarea')].find(x => (x.closest('label')?.innerText ?? '').trim().startsWith('your note')); if (!f) return 'no field'; f.focus(); return document.activeElement === f })()
